description.en: A third-party DeepSeek Harness agent preset based on minimal. It adds one stateless tool, sympy_calculate, which runs a complete Python script in a fresh process against a local SymPy development checkout.
description.zh: 基于 minimal 的第三方 DeepSeek Harness agent 预设，新增无状态工具 sympy_calculate，在新进程中针对本地 SymPy 开发检出运行完整 Python 脚本。

description.en: DSH provider plugin for Codex access through a ChatGPT subscription.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT 订阅访问 Codex 的 DSH 提供方插件。

description.en: Magic Context for DeepSeek Harness — elvisw fork: reversible context reclaim, an out-of-band historian, an m[0]/m[1] baseline, project memories in the plugin's own corpus, and the compaction seam.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Magic Context（elvisw 分支）：可撤销的上下文回收、带外历史记录器、m[0]/m[1] 基线、插件自有语料中的项目记忆，以及压缩接缝。

description.en: Restart recovery for dsh web: after a crash/restart, an interrupted agent turn continues automatically (host-side agent/created listener — no browser timing races). Pairs with the dsh-web-guard skill (which auto-relaunches the web process); together they
description.zh: dsh web 的重启恢复：崩溃或重启后，被中断的 agent 回合自动继续（宿主侧 agent/created 监听，无浏览器时序竞争）。与自动重启 web 进程的 dsh-web-guard 技能配套。

description.en: Track Bridge: embedded task-management engine for DeepSeek Harness — decision-point protocol, capture wall, and Linear-shaped issue store over session events + storage KV
description.zh: Track Bridge：DeepSeek Harness 的内嵌任务管理引擎——决策点协议、捕获墙，以及基于会话事件 + storage KV 的 Linear 式 issue 存储。

description.en: Continuous realtime dictation for the DeepSeek Harness composer, powered by the local SenseVoice recognizer
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的连续实时听写，由本地 SenseVoice 识别器驱动。

description.en: External dsh Web GUI plugin: a Git tab (changes, staging, commits, diffs, history, branches, remotes) registered as a Conversation View, packaged as a dsh profile bundle
description.zh: 外部 dsh Web GUI 插件：以 Conversation View 注册的 Git 标签页（变更、暂存、提交、diff、历史、分支、远程），打包为 dsh profile bundle。

description.en: DSH bundle: key-free web search, page fetch and research for DeepSeek Harness; eight engines fused with RRF, 34 vertical sources, arXiv, Windows/macOS system-proxy support and a dependency-free MCP server.
description.zh: DSH 捆绑包：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免密钥网页搜索、页面抓取与研究；八个引擎以 RRF 融合、34 个垂直来源、arXiv、Windows/macOS 系统代理支持，以及无依赖 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Permanently delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation and every local copy of its data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
description.zh: 永久删除一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话及其所有本地数据副本：会话日志、衍生缓存、工作区索引条目、溢出文件和未引用附件。

description.en: Author your own skills in the Harness Settings page: every entry is published into the skill registry, so the model sees one line and loads the body on demand.
description.zh: 在 Harness 设置页编写自己的技能：每条记录都会发布到技能注册表，模型只看到一行，按需加载正文。

plugins.name: @ggboy123/dsh-paper-reader
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：论文伴读工作台 — PDF 转录 / 检索 / 原生对话伴读 + 内置阅读器页面。
plugins.author: GGboya

description.en: DeepSeek Harness companion for ClineBot / ClinePass: dynamic subscription models sync, quota exhaustion warnings, session metrics, dedicated settings page, live usage limits, and /cline slash-command.
description.zh: ClineBot / ClinePass 的 DeepSeek Harness 配套插件：订阅模型动态同步、配额耗尽提醒、会话指标、专用设置页、实时用量限额，以及 /cline 斜杠命令。

description.en: Background automation runner for DSH: isolated agent runs, script/HTTP/SSH/Docker runtimes, cost guard, notifications, heartbeats.
description.zh: DSH 的后台自动化运行器：隔离的 agent 运行、脚本/HTTP/SSH/Docker 运行时、费用防护、通知与心跳。

description.en: Image generation for DeepSeek Harness: a generate_image tool with pluggable providers — the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription with no API key at all. The picture is shown inline in the conversation; the model rece
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的图像生成：generate_image 工具，提供方可插拔——FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API，或完全无需 API key 的 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅。图片内联显示在会话中，模型……

description.en: Per-provider API key rotation for DeepSeek Harness: a key pool per provider, auto-created clone routes, and switching to the next key on quota/rate-limit errors. Includes a Settings section (Key Rotation) to edit the key pools, cooldown and switch codes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按提供方 API key 轮换：每个提供方一个 key 池、自动创建克隆路由，在配额/限流错误时切换到下一个 key。设置区（Key Rotation）可编辑 key 池、冷却时间和切换状态码。

description.en: Telegram messenger bridge for DeepSeek Harness: sessions, steer, homes, inline asks, notify bridge, and optional TTS voice notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 消息桥：会话、steer、homes、内联提问、通知桥，以及可选的 TTS 语音消息。

description.en: Mixture of Agents (MoA) plugin for DeepSeek Harness with /moa slash command
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Mixture of Agents (MoA) 插件，带 /moa 斜杠命令。

description.en: Ollama Cloud LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 Ollama Cloud LLM 提供方插件。

description.en: OpenCode / OpenCode Go LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 OpenCode / OpenCode Go LLM 提供方插件。

description.en: Enterprise Remote Workspace Plugin for DeepSeek Harness: SSH2 connection pool, SFTP operations, 3-way conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and native DSH UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的企业远程工作区插件：SSH2 连接池、SFTP 操作、三方冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发，以及原生 DSH UI。

description.en: Полная русская локализация DeepSeek Harness (DSH): ядро v0.2.2-rc.3 + 89 плагинов экосистемы, 13,055 -> 18,501 UI keys, 100% покрытие, естественный русский язык
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的完整俄语本地化：核心 v0.2.2-rc.3 + 89 个生态插件，13,055 -> 18,501 个 UI keys，100% 覆盖，自然的俄语。

description.en: Use ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, Antigravity, Kimi, GLM, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains, Perplexity, Replit, and Cody subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers via OAuth.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok、Antigravity、Kimi、GLM、Cursor、Kiro、Copilot、Qwen、ERNIE、Spark、JetBrains、Perplexity、Replit 和 Cody 订阅用作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方。

description.en: Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness: speak agent replies in the Web UI with a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文本转语音：在 Web UI 中朗读 agent 回复，提供方回退链为 OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak。

description.en: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, plus any OpenAI-compatible API of your own).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入：按停顿分块的听写与语音消息，各自拥有提供方回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp，以及你自己的任意 OpenAI 兼容 API）。

description.en: Ask MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and CSV/Excel in plain language inside DeepSeek Harness: charts, dashboards, alerts, and IM push and bots for Lark/Feishu, Telegram, WeCom and DingTalk.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中用自然语言查询 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch 和 CSV/Excel：图表、仪表盘、告警，以及面向 Lark/飞书、Telegram、企业微信和钉钉的 IM 推送与机器人。

description.en: Left-sidebar screen radar for DeepSeek Harness: ranks the movies and series in cinemas now or opening within the next month across China, the US, Europe, Japan and Korea, with real posters, five-sentence synopses, popular comments, a title search that mer
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的左侧栏影院雷达：对中国、美国、欧洲、日本和韩国正在上映或未来一个月内开画的电影与剧集排名，含真实海报、五句话简介、热门评论，以及一个片名搜索……

description.en: Honcho memory for DeepSeek Harness — persistent, cross-session memory that survives context resets and restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Honcho 记忆——持久、跨会话的记忆，能在上下文重置和重启后保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables every write/edit touched and reports what changed
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 捆绑包：对齐每次写入/编辑涉及的 Markdown 竖线表格，并报告改动了什么。

description.en: WorkBuddy model provider for DeepSeek Harness (international + China deployments)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 WorkBuddy 模型提供方（国际版 + 中国版部署）。

description.en: One installable DSH bundle with four independent plugins: the MCP Manager panel (which also drives the OAuth-enabled Streamable HTTP MCP client bridge), the Session Delete UI, the QQ bot bridge, and the per-model session cost meter.
description.zh: 一个可安装的 DSH 捆绑包，含四个独立插件：MCP Manager 面板（同时驱动支持 OAuth 的 Streamable HTTP MCP 客户端桥）、会话删除 UI、QQ 机器人桥，以及按模型统计的会话费用计量。

description.en: Minimal QQ-only IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bind one session to QQ, /new in a default workspace, relay only the final answer, and push from any session through the send_qq_message tool. Configured in Settings → QQ bot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的极简纯 QQ IM 桥：把一个会话绑定到 QQ，在默认工作区 /new，仅转发最终答案，并可通过 send_qq_message 工具从任意会话推送。在 设置 → QQ bot 中配置。

plugins.name: @huanlin/dsh-plugin-better-locale
plugins.description: DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...)

plugins.name: @hui-xu-ai/dsh-wensu
plugins.description: DSH bundle that mounts the wensu (文溯) MCP server over stdio: read-only CNKI and Web of Science bibliographic search.
plugins.author: hui-xu-ai

plugins.name: @iasiv5/dsh-skins
plugins.description: 侧栏多皮肤热切换，一键回官方；壁纸、标语、通透度个性化，明暗随外观自适应，Web 与 Desktop 均可用。

description.en: Check for and install DeepSeek Harness (dsh) releases from the Web UI: a Settings row, a sidebar button, toasts, and an agent tool.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中检查并安装 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 版本：设置项一行、侧边栏按钮、toast 提示，以及一个 agent 工具。

description.en: Agentic-workflow stage 3: mandatory reflection and verification pass that emits an Accountability Report before every final output.
description.zh: Agentic-workflow 第 3 阶段：强制的反思与验证环节，在每次最终输出前生成 Accountability Report。

description.en: The consolidation organ of the J.Franco agentic workflow: one pass over the logs — telemetry, friction points, marketing intelligence, triage review, and grade summary. Folded from usage-auditor and triage (vestigial organs). Created by J.Franco.
description.zh: J.Franco agentic workflow 的整合器官：一次日志遍历——遥测、摩擦点、营销情报、分诊审查与评级摘要。由 usage-auditor 和 triage（退化器官）合并而来。由 J.Franco 创建。

description.en: Governance layer of the J.Franco agentic workflow: grades the reliability of automatic decisions from the supervision log and proposes tier moves — the human approves every change.
description.zh: J.Franco agentic workflow 的治理层：根据监督日志为自动决策的可靠性评级并提出层级调整——每项变更都由人批准。

description.en: Cifra — the host-signature organ of the J.Franco agentic workflow: detects the host (OS + form factor), adapts texts/instructions/layout per platform, and audits the signature visibly. Created by J.Franco.
description.zh: Cifra——J.Franco agentic workflow 的宿主签名器官：检测宿主（OS + 形态），按平台适配文案/指令/布局，并可见地审计签名。由 J.Franco 创建。

description.en: Compás — the platform optimizer organ of the J.Franco agentic workflow: audits Fanal against the optimization checklist distilled from DeepSeek Harness (one brain many skins, token gate, batched state, PWA cache, electron hardening) and applies ONLY what
description.zh: Compás——J.Franco agentic workflow 的平台优化器官：依照从 DeepSeek Harness 提炼的优化清单（一脑多皮、token 门控、批量状态、PWA 缓存、electron 加固）审计 Fanal，并且只应用……

description.en: The teacher organ of the J.Franco agentic workflow: detects friction between the user and the AI (repeated revisions, vague directives, frustration) and delivers micro-lessons from the conductor's guide, with prompt templates. Created by J.Franco.
description.zh: J.Franco agentic workflow 的教师器官：检测用户与 AI 之间的摩擦（反复修改、含糊指令、挫败感），并依据指挥者指南提供微课程与提示词模板。由 J.Franco 创建。

description.en: Agentic-workflow stage 2: route every decision through pre-trained GREEN/YELLOW/RED tiers and keep an audit trail.
description.zh: Agentic-workflow 第 2 阶段：让每个决策经过预训练的 GREEN/YELLOW/RED 层级路由，并保留审计轨迹。

description.en: Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.
description.zh: web GUI 的 DeepSeek API token 实时价格条：峰/谷时段资费、UTC + 本地（魁北克）时钟、下次资费变更倒计时，以及每日对照 DeepSeek 官方价格页自校验。

description.en: The professional document factory of the J.Franco agentic workflow: consulting-grade techniques (boxes that never split pages, repeating table headers, no orphan lines, page numbers, metadata) + the editorial DNA (no meta-pointers, narrative flow, modest
description.zh: J.Franco agentic workflow 的专业文档工厂：咨询级排版技巧（分页不拆框、重复表头、无孤行、页码、元数据）与编辑基因（无元指针、叙事流畅、克制）。

description.en: The code-forensics organ of the J.Franco agentic workflow: the archaeological protocol for understanding how AI-written code was made — trace a feature end to end, read the fossil record (commits, LEARNINGS, triage, audit), and produce a plain-language do
description.zh: J.Franco agentic workflow 的代码取证器官：理解 AI 所写代码如何形成的考古协议——端到端追踪一个功能，读取化石记录（提交、LEARNINGS、分诊、审计），并产出平实语言的……

description.en: Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件编写技能：构建和发布新 DSH 插件所需的精简结构剖析、客户端 UI 配方、slots、locale、主题 token、安装步骤、坑点与验证清单。

description.en: Agentic-workflow trigger layer: listening mode that captures conversations, decodes the requests, and builds the workflow — automatic actions, proposals, and questions.
description.zh: Agentic-workflow 触发层：监听模式，捕获对话、解析请求并构建工作流——自动操作、提案与提问。

description.en: Use ChatGPT accounts with Codex models and a Codex-style conversation view.
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 账号搭配 Codex 模型，并提供 Codex 风格的会话视图。

description.en: Cline free models provider for dsh: scan the Cline model catalog dynamically and serve the :free models through the harness LLM seam
description.zh: dsh 的 Cline 免费模型提供方：动态扫描 Cline 模型目录，并通过 harness LLM 接口提供 :free 模型。

description.en: Command Code Go provider adapter for dsh: scan the Go-plan model catalog dynamically and serve /alpha/generate through the harness LLM seam
description.zh: dsh 的 Command Code Go 提供方适配器：动态扫描 Go 套餐模型目录，并通过 harness LLM 接口提供 /alpha/generate。

description.en: Nous Portal free-tier provider for dsh: Portal OAuth (device-code) agent-key lifecycle behind an OpenAI-compatible harness route
description.zh: dsh 的 Nous Portal 免费额度提供方：在 OpenAI 兼容的 harness 路由后管理 Portal OAuth（设备码）agent-key 生命周期。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free models provider for dsh
description.zh: dsh 的 OpenCode Zen 免费模型提供方。

description.en: Delegate independent tasks to the local Antigravity CLI (agy) from DSH; non-official plugin with a self-contained AGY runtime, startup/stall watchdogs, status and cancel control, and eight-language UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH 把独立任务委派给本地 Antigravity CLI (agy)；非官方插件，带自包含 AGY 运行时、启动/卡顿看门狗、状态与取消控制，以及八语言 UI。

plugins.name: @jiuling/dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.description: MCP 服务器管理器：在 DSH Web GUI 的设置界面中可视化新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 启停 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 配置行，直接读写当前 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml。1.0.3 起适配 DSH 0.2.1（官方删除 webRuntime 服务，信任校验改用 connection.requestRejection）。

plugins.name: @jiuling/dsh-mobile-remote
plugins.description: 手机远程访问 DSH 的一站式插件：移动端 UI 适配 + 公网零配置访问。安装后无论用 frp / ngrok / Cloudflare Tunnel / 路由器端口转发，只要把本地端口映射到公网即可直接用，无需任何额外配置；自带 HTTP Basic Auth 门卫保护公网入口。

description.en: Dream-RSI assessment and bounded, verifier-driven improvement for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Dream-RSI 评估，以及有边界、由验证器驱动的改进。

plugins.name: @jw-king/dsh-plugin-workspaces-extra
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness UI plugin: session deletion (删除会话). Adds a header action on the current session with a confirm dialog; on confirm it terminates the session's agent and removes the session's files and local data.

plugins.name: @jw-king/dsh-plugin-zentao
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that connects ZenTao PMS (禅道) REST API v1 as model tools: products, projects, stories, tasks, bugs and more.

description.en: Heartbeat plugin for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled autonomous reflection loop with user profile, material pool, pace gate, and gated proactive expression.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的心跳插件：带用户画像、素材池、节奏门控和受控主动表达的定时自主反思循环。

description.en: Local-first cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: three-scope SQLite stores (user / project / shared), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF, an evidence gate, provenance audit and SM-2 spaced repetition. 23 narrow tools, zero exter
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先跨会话长期记忆：三作用域 SQLite 存储（user / project / shared）、FTS5 + 本地向量混合检索配 RRF、证据门控、来源审计与 SM-2 间隔重复。23 个窄工具，零外部……

description.en: AI Services: shared model routing, bounded auxiliary calls, and usage receipts for other plugins.
description.zh: AI Services：为其他插件提供共享模型路由、有边界的辅助调用和用量凭证。

description.en: Hide the plugin-info and promotion cards at the top of the dsh-context dashboard.
description.zh: 隐藏 dsh-context 仪表盘顶部的插件信息与推广卡片。

description.en: Auto Title: keep session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.
description.zh: Auto Title：让会话标题跟随最新任务；你手动设置的名称保持不变。

description.en: Delegation Mode: a per-session switch where the main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work.
description.zh: Delegation Mode：按会话切换，主 agent 规划、委派和审查，由子 agent 执行工作。

description.en: DSH Docs: browse official DSH developer documentation in the Plugins page; in Creator mode the agent also gets two read-only tools to search docs and inspect plugins across the catalog, npm, and GitHub (dsh_docs, dsh_plugins).
description.zh: DSH Docs：在插件页浏览官方 DSH 开发者文档；Creator 模式下 agent 还会得到两个只读工具，用于搜索文档并在目录、npm 和 GitHub 中查看插件（dsh_docs、dsh_plugins）。

description.en: Font: customize the interface, conversation, code and terminal fonts and font sizes of the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: Font：自定义 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的界面、会话、代码和终端字体及字号。

description.en: Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping commits and generating commit messages.
description.zh: Git Commit：在会话中提交工作区变更，由模型分组提交并生成提交信息。

description.en: Magpie: connect DSH to a Magpie gateway on this computer, your local network or elsewhere, and sync its models, default model and web search; supports local LLMs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
description.zh: Magpie：把 DSH 连接到本机、局域网或其他位置的 Magpie 网关，并同步其模型、默认模型与网页搜索；支持本地 LLM 和 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Long-term Memory: remember vocabulary, preferences, and recent activity per scope, consolidated by Dream.
description.zh: Long-term Memory：按作用域记住词汇、偏好和近期活动，由 Dream 整合。

description.en: Model Center: configure model tiers, provider connections, and AI call limits.
description.zh: Model Center：配置模型层级、提供方连接和 AI 调用限额。

description.en: Subagents: configure models and reasoning effort, review each subagent's last-used model, and use per-session delegation mode.
description.zh: Subagents：配置模型与推理强度，查看每个子 agent 上次使用的模型，并使用按会话的委派模式。

description.en: Pick a model and reasoning effort in the composer from periodic-table style cards or a searchable list; other plugins can reuse it.
description.zh: 在输入框中通过元素周期表风格卡片或可搜索列表选择模型与推理强度；其他插件可以复用。

description.en: Requirements: the current agent records, reads, and updates this task's requirements, with no extra model calls.
description.zh: Requirements：当前 agent 记录、读取并更新本任务的需求，不产生额外模型调用。

description.en: Prompt Override: adds a working contract to DSH's native system prompt and rewrites its terse built-in tool guidance, in every session.
description.zh: Prompt Override：在每个会话中为 DSH 原生系统提示加入工作契约，并改写其简略的内置工具指引。

description.en: Session Recap: write session recaps in the background and give the agent bounded progress checkpoints.
description.zh: Session Recap：在后台撰写会话回顾，并为 agent 提供有边界的进度检查点。

description.en: Safe Auto: a reviewer model answers approval requests one call at a time; includes review history with full audit trails.
description.zh: Safe Auto：由审查模型逐次调用应答批准请求；包含带完整审计轨迹的审查历史。

description.en: Collect secrets outside chat and use named references with per-session HTTP and shell permissions.
description.zh: 在聊天之外收集密钥，使用具名引用，并按会话授予 HTTP 和 shell 权限。

description.en: Experience Learning: learn conditional methods from outcome evidence, with optional export as skills.
description.zh: Experience Learning：从结果证据中学习条件性方法，可选导出为技能。

description.en: Search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a reply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork the current s
description.zh: 跨工作目录搜索和读取 DeepSeek Harness 会话，使用临时工作区，回复提前中断时一键或自动继续，回来时附上下文压缩提示做回顾，并可选让 agent fork 当前……

description.en: Unrestricted: a session preset that removes the limits on what the model answers and delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it. May get your account banned.
description.zh: Unrestricted：一个会话预设，取消对模型回答内容的限制并给出完整结果，仅在选用它的会话中生效。可能导致账号被封禁。

description.en: Preview GitHub Release changelogs before updating DeepSeek Harness or any installed third-party plugin, and apply updates only after explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 在更新 DeepSeek Harness 或任何已安装第三方插件前预览 GitHub Release 更新日志，仅在明确确认后应用更新。

description.en: Orchestrate multi-source web search (parallel RRF fusion, failover, single) and waterfall page reading in one settings page—with built-in DuckDuckGo, Jina Reader, Exa, Tavily, Linkup, Zhipu, and plugin sources—for the model's web_search and web_fetch tool
description.zh: 在一个设置页中编排多源网页搜索（并行 RRF 融合、故障转移、单一）和瀑布式页面阅读——内置 DuckDuckGo、Jina Reader、Exa、Tavily、Linkup、Zhipu 及插件来源——供模型的 web_search 和 web_fetch 工具……

description.en: Search Zhihu and the web, browse hot lists, Zhida, knowledge bases, Q&A, creator data, and drafts, and export local reports for deep research, opinion comparison, and rolling 30-day briefings.
description.zh: 搜索知乎和网页，浏览热榜、直答、知识库、问答、创作者数据和草稿，并导出本地报告，用于深度研究、观点对比和滚动 30 天简报。

description.en: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, charts, tables, layers and local controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内的 ChatGPT 风格富答案：实体面板、KPI 卡片、图表、表格、图层和本地控件。

plugins.name: @laplaceliu/unwr
plugins.description: UnWr — Unlimited Writing. 无限写作，小说写作 AI 智能体，DeepSeek Harness 组合包（bundle）。

plugins.name: @leiyi-works/dsh-cloud-sync
plugins.description: 云端同步 0.11.46：移除 sync-busy 标记（由 resume-sync 未完成标记统一覆盖：打断后启动自动续同步），插件自动更新后拦截本轮、重启后自动续。
plugins.author: leiyi-works

description.en: Local and remote knowledge bases for DeepSeek Harness, with scoped recall, controlled write-back, and a Web management console
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地与远程知识库，带按作用域召回、受控回写和 Web 管理控制台。

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with QQ, WeChat, Matrix and Mattermost channels for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可长期运行的 AI 伙伴，支持 QQ、微信、Matrix 和 Mattermost 频道。

description.en: Secure SSH, FTP/FTPS/SFTP file transfer, browser terminals, proxies, port forwarding, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全 SSH、FTP/FTPS/SFTP 文件传输、浏览器终端、代理、端口转发和按会话隔离的 AI 访问。

description.en: Remind you when a DSH session task finishes or waits on you: branded Windows toast, audible cue, and an SRA-compatible webhook.
description.zh: 当 DSH 会话任务完成或等待你处理时提醒你：品牌化 Windows toast、提示音，以及 SRA 兼容 webhook。

description.en: Real-time quotes for A-share, Hong Kong and US listings: the stock_quote and stock_search tools, a watchlist page, and a per-stock page with daily candles and an AI analysis prompt.
description.zh: A 股、港股和美股实时行情：stock_quote 和 stock_search 工具、自选列表页，以及含日 K 线和 AI 分析提示的个股页。

description.en: DSH bundle: push Bark notifications to iPhone and Apple Watch when an agent finishes a run, needs approval, or errors out.
description.zh: DSH 捆绑包：当 agent 完成运行、需要批准或出错时，向 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 推送 Bark 通知。

description.en: Presmium's bundle for DeepSeek Harness: the workbench of presmium studio, its host side (Presmium's tools, approvals, document context, skills and routes) and its client side (the root layout and the workbench's panels, precompiled) (experimental)
description.zh: Presmium 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的捆绑包：p presmium studio 的工作台，其宿主侧（Presmium 的工具、审批、文档上下文、技能与路由）和客户端侧（根布局与工作台面板，已预编译）（实验性）。

plugins.name: @littlebugyang/dsh-study-mode
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) profile bundle that declares the 学习模式 (study-mode) agent preset — a full coding agent that teaches while it works: the `teach` skill drives a probe → plan → teach loop, and the graded `quiz` tool checks that each node actually lande

description.en: A real PowerPoint, not HTML. Editable .pptx decks for AI agents, rendered on your own machine.
description.zh: 真正的 PowerPoint，不是 HTML。为 AI agent 生成可编辑的 .pptx 演示文稿，在你自己的机器上渲染。

description.en: Pin workspaces whose sessions are running or waiting for your reply to the top of the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 把有会话正在运行或等待你回复的工作区置顶到 DSH 侧边栏。

description.en: Project-level cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: .memory/MEMORY.md index in prompt context, on-demand recall, compaction snapshots, and memory_add/memory_query/memory_status/memory_dream tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目级跨会话记忆：提示上下文中的 .memory/MEMORY.md 索引、按需召回、压缩快照，以及 memory_add/memory_query/memory_status/memory_dream 工具。

description.en: Native system notification banners and a Dock badge when DSH waits for your answer, waits for approval, or finishes a turn.
description.zh: 当 DSH 等待你回答、等待批准或完成一个回合时，显示原生系统通知横幅和 Dock 标记。

description.en: DSH bundle: re-inject KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN variables from the launching environment into dsh bash subprocesses under their original names, with a configurable pattern in the Plugins page
description.zh: DSH 捆绑包：把启动环境中的 KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN 变量以原名重新注入 dsh bash 子进程，可在插件页配置匹配模式。

description.en: Writes a model-generated next-step suggestion into the DSH composer placeholder after each turn; Tab (desktop) or tap (touch devices) fills it into the draft.
description.zh: 在每个回合后把模型生成的下一步建议写入 DSH 输入框占位符；按 Tab（桌面）或轻触（触屏设备）即可填入草稿。

description.en: DSH bundle: expose your local dsh web on a port for any tunnel or reverse proxy, with Host/Origin rewriting, LAN access, mobile web styling and an in-DSH settings card
description.zh: DSH 捆绑包：在某个端口暴露本地 dsh web，供任意隧道或反向代理使用，带 Host/Origin 重写、局域网访问、移动端网页样式和 DSH 内设置卡片。

description.en: DSH bundle adding a copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box's copy while the real disk is untouched.
description.zh: DSH 捆绑包，新增 copy-on-write 权限预设：shell 命令在每个工作区专属的 Sandboxie 沙箱中运行，工作区之外的写入落在沙箱副本里，真实磁盘不受影响。

description.en: Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: after a turn settles, the empty composer shows a dimmed suggestion of your next message; Tab accepts it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 风格输入预测：回合结束后，空输入框显示你下一条消息的淡化建议；按 Tab 采纳。

plugins.name: @luolingp/request-doctor
plugins.description: 自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。

plugins.author: 李永轩

description.en: A resident coordinating agent that scopes work, dispatches it to independent sessions, verifies the results, and reports back.
description.zh: 常驻的协调 agent：界定工作范围，派发到独立会话，验证结果并回报。

description.en: DSH Studio: role-based multi-agent workspace (product / architect / developer / QA) with a live work board, GitLab + Feishu connection settings, all configurable from the web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Studio：基于角色的多 agent 工作区（product / architect / developer / QA），带实时工作看板、GitLab + 飞书连接设置，全部可在 web GUI 中配置。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory plugin for the DeepSeek Harness — deterministic BM25 recall, writes take effect immediately, signal-driven injection, no embeddings
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话明文记忆插件——确定性 BM25 召回、写入立即生效、信号驱动注入，不使用 embedding。

description.en: Reflect2Evolve memory plugin: layered L1/L2/L3 memory, reflection-weighted value backprop, cross-task policy induction, skill crystallization, and three-tier retrieval for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Reflect2Evolve 记忆插件：分层 L1/L2/L3 记忆、反思加权的价值回传、跨任务策略归纳、技能结晶，以及面向 OpenClaw、Hermes Agent 和 DeepSeek Harness 的三级检索。

plugins.name: @michengai/dsh-code-review
plugins.description: DSH Code Review — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格代码审查、原生独立子 Agent、灵活范围选择和中英文报告 · Codex-style code review with native independent agents, flexible scope selection, and bilingual reports for DSH
plugins.author: MichengAI

plugins.name: @michengai/dsh-codex-pet
plugins.description: DSH Codex Pet — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宠物陪伴、多任务提醒与交互，以及 Skill 自定义宠物 · A pet companion with multi-task notifications, interactions, and Skill-based custom pets for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.author: MichengAI

plugins.name: @michengai/dsh-pua
plugins.description: DSH PUA — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PUA 任务推进、角色风味、验收循环和运行状态卡片 · PUA task persistence, personas, verification loops, and live status cards for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.author: MichengAI

plugins.name: @michengai/dsh-simplify
plugins.description: DSH Simplify — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供限定 Git 变更范围的代码简化，支持未跟踪文件、跨平台路径与可靠的 Git 异常处理 · Git-scoped code simplification with untracked-file support, cross-platform paths, and reliable Git error handling for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.author: MichengAI

plugins.name: @microi.net/cli
plugins.description: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付

plugins.description: DSH 桌面版插件：设置页新增「桌面模式」分组，开关一键开启桌面版（独立窗口 + 桌面快捷方式）。

plugins.name: @midnightbell/dsh-wallpaper-theme
plugins.description: DSH 背景壁纸主题插件：设置页「背景主题」入口，渐变预设/本地图片/剪贴板/图片链接，设置持久化到 DSH_HOME，重启自动恢复。

plugins.name: @modesto_ma/dsh-channels
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 飞书渠道插件：一个 dsh 实例对应一个飞书机器人，私聊/群聊/话题群 @ 触发会话，话题绑定 session，卡片 2.0 流式回复；Web 左侧栏提供「飞书渠道」状态与常用配置面板

plugins.name: @mohuang26/dsh-task-notice
plugins.description: DSH 插件：任务完成或等你回复时发出操作系统级通知（右下角横幅 + 通知中心）
plugins.author: mohuang26

description.en: Personal dsh profile bundle: registers the coding / chat agent presets — each with its own isolated injection channel (context assembler) and injection rows, so no other preset is touched.
description.zh: 个人 dsh profile bundle：注册 coding / chat agent 预设——每个预设都有各自隔离的注入通道（上下文组装器）和注入行，不触碰其他预设。

description.en: Personal dsh profile bundle: disables the shipped agent presets, builds generated standard / ptc presets into dist, declares personal llm-pi-ai provider routes, and carries the deployment sandbox access rules.
description.zh: 个人 dsh profile bundle：禁用随附的 agent 预设，把生成的标准 / ptc 预设构建进 dist，声明个人 llm-pi-ai 提供方路由，并携带部署沙箱访问规则。

plugins.name: @morlay/dsh-profile
plugins.description: Personal dsh profile: 配置初始化层——只给 llm route、welcome notice、搜索后端选择与沙箱访问规则这类 config 值；行的装配（禁官方行 / 插能力行）归各能力包自己的 bundle。

plugins.name: @morlay/mydsh-profile
plugins.description: 我的 dsh 个人配置项：界面语言、欢迎提示版本、默认模型与对话视图，外加统一声明的四份 agent preset（复制上游，删掉与 agent-team 冲突的子代理工具行）。

plugins.name: @morlay/ollama-provider-profile
plugins.description: Ollama 一家：llm-pi-ai 的 ollama provider、web_search 走 ollama 后端（含 web 行的 provider 选择）一次配齐。

plugins.name: @morlay/sandbox-profile
plugins.description: 可配置沙箱与审批的运行时策略面：禁用官方 sandbox / fs-sandbox 两行、插入替换行、给出访问规则的值，由替换行接管运行时快照（sandbox:policy / approval:policy）。

plugins.name: @morlay/session-mode-profile
plugins.description: 会话模式与注入面：会话模式行（各模式的 persona、工具与 policy 名单、开关；按会话收口也由它内部持有）+ subagent 服务接管行 + 注入通道 + 工具说明（汉化 / 用法分组），一次装齐；行清单归会话挂着的 shipped preset，本包不自建 preset。

description.en: Dev-only dsh profile bundle: mounts @morlay/dsh-client-modules (our vite + federated prebundle frontend chain) and disables the upstream module-table rows it replaces — shared by `dshdev web` and `dshdev desktop`.
description.zh: 仅供开发用的 dsh profile bundle：挂载 @morlay/dsh-client-modules（我们的 vite + 联邦预打包前端链路），并禁用它所替换的上游模块表行——由 `dshdev web` 和 `dshdev desktop` 共用。

plugins.description: 通用 MCP 接法的一次装齐：agent-browser 与 agent-desktop 各一行 dsh-mcp-client，工具以 mcp__agent-browser__* / mcp__agent-desktop__* 进入模型目录；命令走全局 PATH 里的 bin，没装则该功能自然不可用。

description.en: Morning Star harness dsh (DeepSeek Harness) cordis function plugin — in-process engine gates (status/dispatch/lease) with hard refusal channels.
description.zh: Morning Star harness dsh（DeepSeek Harness）cordis 函数插件——进程内引擎门控（status/dispatch/lease），带硬性拒绝通道。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的智能 UI：模型用 openui-lang 程序作答，Web GUI 在聊天中将其渲染为实时、可交互的 UI。

description.en: Catppuccin themes + a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the official theme system (Appearance settings), fully remapping the --dsw-* token ladder, with adjustable frosted gl
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题 + 可切换玻璃拟态皮肤——Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 和 Mocha 注册进官方主题系统（外观设置），完整重映射 --dsw-* token 阶梯，毛玻璃可调……

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Octen 网页搜索与抓取：web_search 走 Octen /search，web_fetch 走 Octen /extract。

description.en: Choose the model and reasoning effort, then execute, compact-and-execute, or start fresh with a reviewed plan.
description.zh: 选择模型与推理强度，然后执行、压缩后执行，或按已审查的计划重新开始。

description.en: DSH web plugin: VSCode Remote-SSH-like remote development (SSH to supercomputers/servers, remote workspace, file explorer, integrated terminal), integrated with dsh-better-sidebar and DSH settings.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：类似 VSCode Remote-SSH 的远程开发（SSH 连接超算/服务器、远程工作区、文件浏览器、集成终端），与 dsh-better-sidebar 和 DSH 设置集成。

description.en: PaperDesk: a Mendeley-style paper library for DeepSeek Harness — import PDFs, keep notes and highlights, ask the agent to explain papers, and sync the library folder through your cloud drive.
description.zh: PaperDesk：DeepSeek Harness 的 Mendeley 式论文库——导入 PDF、保存笔记与高亮、让 Agent 讲解论文，并可通过云盘同步库文件夹。

plugins.name: @zhuifengqug/dsh-mantis
plugins.description: 虫珀 · 拒斧：装在本机的 DeepSeek Harness 红队评测与宿主清洗插件。面板里一键清洗提示词、审批与沙箱策略，逐条可回滚，只动本机 @deepseek-ai 包。

plugins.name: @ziduup/dsh-programming-mode
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 编程模式组合包：标准模式之上强制执行 Superpowers 工程纪律（TDD、系统化调试、先计划后编码、完成前验证、代码审查），常驻 Ponytail 代码量纪律，内置全套 superpowers 与 ponytail 技能，dsh plugin add 一键安装。
plugins.author: 子都

description.en: Markdown files under ~/.agents/commands become explicit slash commands that inject their full text into the user prompt.
description.zh: ~/.agents/commands 下的 Markdown 文件会成为显式斜杠命令，把其全文注入用户提示词。

plugins.name: @zrzring/dsh-desktop-notifications
plugins.description: 任务**完成**、**失败**或**等待你确认**时，弹一条系统通知（可单独开提示音）。

description.en: Edit a sent prompt and resend it in a new branch, plus a triangle Continue button that resumes a stopped or truncated turn.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的提示词并在新分支中重发，另有一个三角形 Continue 按钮可继续被停止或截断的回合。

description.en: AuraCardea — folds one Turn's intermediate chat rows (tool calls, reasoning, context injections, retries) into one line per kind, with live status, success/failure counts, per-kind duration and inline details.
description.zh: AuraCardea——把一个 Turn 的中间聊天行（工具调用、推理、上下文注入、重试）按种类折叠成一行，带实时状态、成功/失败计数、各类耗时和内联详情。

description.en: Bailian knowledge-base tools for DeepSeek Harness: kb_search and kb_chat over the DashScope RAG API, plus the bl CLI management skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的百炼知识库工具：基于 DashScope RAG API 的 kb_search 和 kb_chat，以及 bl CLI 管理技能。

plugins.name: balance-dsh
plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和当前会话 token/费用消耗（含高峰/空闲峰谷计费）。仅支持 DeepSeek 官方模型与账号，暂不支持其他大模型。
plugins.author: Rannist

description.en: Delete a conversation from the DSH sidebar instead of only archiving it, and see the whole family it spawned — every subagent session and derived conversation, nested — before choosing which of them go with it; delete many at once from the trash icon besi
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏中删除会话而不只是归档，并可在删除前查看它衍生出的整个家族——所有子 Agent 会话和派生会话，按嵌套展示——再选择哪些一并删除；可通过垃圾桶图标批量删除…

description.en: Active Context Pruning (ACP) for the DeepSeek Harness — model-driven context management as a CompactionEngine backend.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的主动上下文裁剪（ACP）——以 CompactionEngine 后端实现的模型驱动上下文管理。

plugins.name: canvas-workbench
plugins.description: 本地生图工作台,零订阅费:开自己的 API 生图(任意 OpenAI 兼容接口,零订阅),画布排版+修图/擦除/去背景/OCR/转矢量,可编辑 PSD/AI 交付,Photoshop/Illustrator 图层级双向桥接

description.en: DSH/Cordis Web plugin: a zoomable relation graph of every loaded plugin - dependencies, resolved providers, and Loader-tree nesting - as a Settings tab next to 'Plugin list'.
description.zh: DSH/Cordis Web 插件：以可缩放的关系图展示每个已加载插件——依赖、已解析的提供者和 Loader 树嵌套——作为“插件列表”旁的一个设置标签页。

description.en: Deep View: interactive views (charts, tables, inputs, answers) in any DeepSeek Harness chat
description.zh: Deep View：在任意 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中提供交互式视图（图表、表格、输入、回答）。

description.en: Local reverse proxy for the DeepInfra API (injects service_tier/fail_fast, falls back between Standard and Flex with per-session cooldown locks), shipped as a DSH profile bundle with a per-session composer toggle and a page in DSH's own Settings dialog; w
description.zh: DeepInfra API 的本地反向代理（注入 service_tier/fail_fast，在 Standard 与 Flex 之间回退并带按会话冷却锁），以 DSH 配置 bundle 发布，含按会话的输入框开关和 DSH 设置对话框中的页面；…

plugins.name: deepseek-computer-use
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Windows 桌面操作插件：窗口截图、界面控件树、鼠标键盘、会话授权与操作审计。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR.
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666

description.en: Attention Manifest Protocol (AMP 0.14.0) host for DeepSeek Harness: eighteen agent modules with sixty-four verbs, a discovery surface, an executable kernel, notification surfaces, model-aware value quantification, a native intake popup flow and read-only
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的注意力清单协议（AMP 0.14.0）宿主：18 个 Agent 模块、64 个动词、发现面、可执行内核、通知面、模型感知的价值量化、原生接入弹窗流程，以及只读…

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Intelligent UI: generative, interactive UI in the chat (declarative component catalog + sandboxed streaming HTML widgets), inspired by CopilotKit OpenIntelligentUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能 UI：聊天中的生成式交互 UI（声明式组件目录 + 沙箱化流式 HTML 组件），灵感来自 CopilotKit OpenIntelligentUI。

plugins.name: deepseek-usage
plugins.description: DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量与预算面板：官方模式读取宿主已登录账号的余额、账单、每日用量与费用；本地模式读取 DSH 全部 Provider 的会话日志，按可编辑的逐模型费率估算 Token、费用和 API 次数，支持用量日历、趋势、模型排行、会话排行与官方/本地对账。支持主题切换，以及侧边栏 Token、消费、API 次数指标的开关、改名、换图标和拖动排序；可设置每日 Token／CNY 限额，达到上限后熔断所有后续模型调用，在状态栏显示红色告警并在对应会话返回失败原因，北京时间次日自动恢复；顶

description.en: Tobs (formerly DeepSeekBot): Team of bots, with persistent identity and memory on DeepSeek Harness. Legacy package and commands remain supported.
description.zh: Tobs（原 DeepSeekBot）：在 DeepSeek Harness 上拥有持久身份与记忆的机器人团队。旧包名和命令仍然受支持。

description.en: Evidence-backed UI delivery for coding agents working on existing Web products: declared criteria, criterion-bound artifacts, findings linked to declarations, and repair guidance. Evaluator review does not replace human semantic approval.
description.zh: 面向处理既有 Web 产品的编码 Agent、有证据支撑的 UI 交付：声明验收标准、绑定标准的产物、关联到声明的发现，以及修复指引。评估者复核不替代人工语义批准。

description.en: Dorothy (dot): an always-on coordinator for DeepSeek Harness. Talk to Dorothy in her own panel, and she opens workspaces, starts sessions, follows their progress, settles their approvals and questions for you, and reports back.
description.zh: Dorothy（dot）：DeepSeek Harness 的常驻协调者。在她自己的面板中与她对话，她会打开工作区、启动会话、跟进进度、替你处理审批和提问，并回报结果。

description.en: One plugin, two surfaces of health checks — DeepSeek Harness skills, plus agent configuration (instruction files, subagent definitions, agent presets), scored on one shared S~E 18-bucket grade scale, with a four-axis classification (role/kind/scope/state,
description.zh: 一个插件，两个健康检查面——DeepSeek Harness 技能，加上 Agent 配置（指令文件、子 Agent 定义、Agent 预设），共用一套 S~E 18 档评分，并带四轴分类（角色/种类/范围/状态…

description.en: A2A protocol for DSH: expose a DSH Session as a standard A2A agent, call remote A2A agents, and run invite-only collaboration groups where a group is itself an A2A agent behind a gateway.
description.zh: DSH 的 A2A 协议：把 DSH 会话作为标准 A2A Agent 暴露，调用远程 A2A Agent，并运行仅限邀请的协作组——组本身即是网关后的一个 A2A Agent。

description.en: dsh plugin bundle porting the omp advisor subsystem: a per-session reviewer model that observes the primary transcript and injects severity-ranked advice (nit/concern/blocker).
description.zh: 移植 omp 顾问子系统的 dsh 插件 bundle：一个按会话的审阅模型，观察主对话记录并注入按严重度排序的建议（nit/concern/blocker）。

description.en: Put your own image where the DSH Web GUI's sidebar brand mark goes (client half, sidebar.brand.mark) and override the page favicon (host half via webServer.tapIndex). Ships default icons in lib/; set config.iconPath to use your own PNG.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 侧栏品牌标记换成你自己的图片（客户端部分，sidebar.brand.mark），并覆盖页面 favicon（Host 部分，通过 webServer.tapIndex）。lib/ 中自带默认图标；设置 config.iconPath 即可使用自己的 PNG。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-lines
plugins.description: DSH Agent 的持久、可寻址消息线（社区插件）。
plugins.author: Lencen

description.en: Workspace personas for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): create many system-prompt personas and scope each one by workspace path or session id (exact / prefix / regex / contains), managed from a Web settings page with Markdown editing and AI tuning.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的工作区人设：创建多个系统提示词人设，并按工作区路径或会话 id（精确/前缀/正则/包含）限定每个的作用范围，通过支持 Markdown 编辑和 AI 调优的 Web 设置页管理。

description.en: Skills and extensions manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Install Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kimi plugin repositories as they are, without waiting for a DSH port.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的技能与扩展管理器。可直接安装 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Kimi 插件仓库，无需等待 DSH 移植。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-soul
plugins.description: 给 DSH 的 agent 一套会忘事的记忆、一份会变的人格和一份会起伏的心情：每轮注入人格 / 记忆 / 笔记 / 目的四段上下文，心情自己判起伏、再补一段状态与语气（可关）；记忆按人的规律衰减（清晰→模糊→只剩印象→遗忘），「心里惦记的事」让她的主动有连续性。
plugins.author: 单树见月

description.en: Constrain when the agent may spawn subagents or teammates: adversarial review and one-shot context reading only.
description.zh: 限制 Agent 何时可以创建子 Agent 或队友：仅用于对抗性评审和一次性上下文阅读。

plugins.name: dsh-agile-workbench
plugins.description: PM工作台（Agile Workbench）套装 bundle：一次安装装齐工作台启动器、记忆插件、浏览器插件、搜索插件、视觉插件与安全搜索 MCP。
plugins.author: 徐野风

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Google Antigravity（agy CLI）模型——把 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅流式接入 DSH，支持思考、工具活动、token 用量和 GUI 内 Google OAuth 登录。

description.en: Multi-agent collaboration cluster for DeepSeek Harness: shared #seq message board, doorbell-based wakeups, zero-token sleeping, hot model switching, and a live feed/topology panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多 Agent 协作集群：共享 #seq 留言板、基于门铃的唤醒、零 token 休眠、热切换模型，以及实时动态/拓扑面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Cordis bundle that mirrors session state into the AI Terminal Pet desktop overlay (Windows).
description.zh: 把会话状态镜像到 AI Terminal Pet 桌面浮层（Windows）的 DeepSeek Harness Cordis bundle。

description.en: AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness: 43 native research tools, natural-language /ai4s-* commands, papers, scholars, patents, full text, references and scientific figures. Powered by ai4scholar.net.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI4Scholar：43 个原生科研工具、自然语言 /ai4s-* 命令，涵盖论文、学者、专利、全文、参考文献和科学图表。由 ai4scholar.net 提供支持。

description.en: See what a conversation feeds the model, what your rules keep out, and what one click would change.
description.zh: 看清一次对话向模型输入了什么、你的规则挡掉了什么，以及点击一次会改变什么。

plugins.name: dsh-aiyayi
plugins.description: 阿依娅伊：一个有独立人格和长期记忆的对话伙伴，动手的活交给她的子智能体。
plugins.author: 巴依浩爷

description.en: Anime airing board and capture triage for DeepSeek Harness — today's lineup from Bangumi, plus local capture records from IINA.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的新番播出表与录制分诊——来自 Bangumi 的今日节目单，加上 IINA 的本地录制记录。

description.en: Appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: custom theme color (PS-style color wheel), background wallpaper with opacity/blur controls, and separate main/settings interface opacity.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观插件：自定义主题色（PS 风格色轮）、带透明度和模糊控制的背景壁纸，以及主界面/设置界面各自独立的透明度。

description.en: Session archive for the DeepSeek Harness: CRUD over historical sessions, plus a PDCA alchemy loop that mines them into measurable context and tool-layer patches (tool-layer recursive self-improvement), with a management panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话归档：对历史会话做增删改查，并用 PDCA 炼金循环把它们挖掘为可度量的上下文与工具层补丁（工具层递归自我改进），配有管理面板。

plugins.name: dsh-arknights-theme
plugins.description: 一款专为粥批定制的明日方舟主题拓展包：背景里的阿米娅与各处细节中的干员签名都在提醒你——博士，您还有许多事情需要处理，现在还不能休息哦。支持导入本地图片作壁纸（导入即解算玻璃浓度与文字色），内置 12 张按画面自适应的整屏壁纸；罗德岛图标体系与签名式的授权、选择交互。 / An Arknights theme pack for the players of 明日方舟: import a local picture as your wallpaper — glass and ink are solved o
plugins.author: Theflowyears

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace, Left/Right switch workspaces.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上下键切换当前工作区内的会话，左右键切换工作区。

description.en: Run coding agents in a separate copy of your project: Solo, Swarm, Conductor or Fusion — review the changes, apply them yourself.
description.zh: 在项目的一个独立副本中运行编码 Agent：Solo、Swarm、Conductor 或 Fusion——由你审阅改动并自行应用。

description.en: ComfyUI-native image generation for DeepSeek Harness: chat tools, creative canvas, Studio workbench, workflow comparison, and built-in server control.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ComfyUI 原生图像生成：聊天工具、创意画布、Studio 工作台、工作流对比和内置服务器控制。

description.en: Google-AI-Studio-style turn controls for DeepSeek Harness, in one install: edit a prompt and re-run it, re-run a reply in place, delete a turn from the model context, render sent prompts as Markdown, and trim idle session logs on boot. Self-contained: the
description.zh: 一次安装即得 Google AI Studio 式的回合控制：编辑提示词并重跑、就地重跑某条回复、从模型上下文中删除某个回合、把已发送的提示词渲染为 Markdown，并在启动时清理闲置会话日志。自包含…

description.en: HTTP ingress that lets AstrBot drive DeepSeek Harness agents (OneBot / official IM via AstrBot).
description.zh: HTTP 入口，让 AstrBot 驱动 DeepSeek Harness Agent（通过 AstrBot 接入 OneBot / 官方 IM）。

plugins.name: dsh-astro-plan
plugins.description: 星野计划（by Sirius YANG）：按 18 类天象与深空目标、全国 173 站、最长一年检索，结合光污染、方位、月相、星历事件与 7 天天气，给出推荐排序、地景、焦段与曝光；每条结果附 Stellarium 风格 3D 天球画面模拟（真实银河等值线、真实月相、实测天际线）。
plugins.author: Sirius YANG

plugins.name: dsh-audiobook
plugins.description: Turn any book into an audiobook in DSH: search public-domain libraries or import EPUB / PDF / TXT, listen, download as MP3 with subtitles, voice-note your thoughts and discuss with AI. · 搜书听：搜书、听书、转 MP3 下载、语音记心得。
plugins.author: AIcivilization

description.en: Persistent audit ledger + precise rollback for DeepSeek Harness file-tool edits: capture pre-edit bytes into a content-addressed store per turn, roll back offline via a standalone CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 文件工具编辑提供持久审计账本和精确回滚：按回合把编辑前字节存入内容寻址存储，可通过独立 CLI 离线回滚。

description.en: Give the local listener a header budget large enough for its own launch cookies, and retire the cookies of every earlier start, so the desktop welcome handshake cannot lock a profile out after ~72 restarts.
description.zh: 为本地监听器提供足以容纳自身启动 cookie 的头部预算，并作废此前每次启动的 cookie，使桌面欢迎握手在约 72 次重启后也不会把配置锁死。

description.en: Serve the local DSH Web UI without the launch-token gate; the Host/Origin fence stays.
description.zh: 在不启用启动 token 校验的情况下提供本地 DSH Web UI 服务；Host/Origin 防护仍然保留。

description.en: Per-turn reasoning effort picker for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a short task card and lets DeepSeek pick off/low/high/max for every message, in the same turn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按回合推理力度选择器：保留一份简短任务卡，让 DeepSeek 在同一回合内为每条消息选择 off/low/high/max。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-review-router
plugins.description: 可指定模型的 Auto 审查：reviewer 路由来自插件配置，缺省回退当前会话。

description.en: DSH plugin: restarts only when every session is idle, waits for plugin installs, then resumes the sessions it interrupted; adds a countdown shutdown, a pre-restart snapshot, and a windowless launcher.
description.zh: DSH 插件：仅在所有会话空闲时重启，等待插件安装完成，然后恢复被中断的会话；另含倒计时关机、重启前快照和无窗口启动器。

description.en: Appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: an ordered list of model rules, each carrying its own wallpapers — every image with its own framing and theme color — plus layout mode, opacity, brightness and blur; the background follows the model you switch to, a
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观插件：一份有序的模型规则列表，每条规则自带壁纸——每张图有自己的取景和主题色——外加布局模式、透明度、亮度和模糊；背景随你切换的模型变化…

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin embedding the Backlog.md Markdown kanban board in a sidebar panel and conversation tab, with one backlog browser process per workspace.
description.zh: 把 Backlog.md Markdown 看板嵌入侧栏面板和会话标签页的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，每个工作区一个 backlog 浏览进程。

description.en: Alibaba Bailian (DashScope) model catalog preset + auto-adapter for DeepSeek Harness — reasoning effort levels, thinking budgets, context windows, auto-adaptation of existing Bailian routes, a configurable context ceiling
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的阿里百炼（DashScope）模型目录预设与自动适配器——推理力度档位、思考预算、上下文窗口、既有百炼路由的自动适配、可配置的上下文上限。

description.en: Workspace-aware BaseMind MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: every session gets BaseMind's code-intelligence tools for the repository it works in, with no MCP row to configure.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、感知工作区的 BaseMind MCP 桥接：每个会话都会获得针对其所在仓库的 BaseMind 代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。

description.en: DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, WSL or Niubash on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback
description.zh: DSH 插件：一个 shell 工具，在 Windows 上可通过 PowerShell、Git Bash、MSYS2、WSL 或 Niubash 运行命令；另有用于底部停靠栏（dsh-better-sidebar 的终端标签页）的内嵌终端，带各 shell 启用开关和默认 shell 回退。

description.en: BETA battle mode for DeepSeek Harness — a commander-led agent cluster (commander, executors, reviewers) whose context is rebuilt from the project's work log instead of an expensive summarization call
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 BETA 战斗模式——由指挥官率领的 Agent 集群（指挥官、执行者、评审者），其上下文从项目工作日志重建，而非调用昂贵的摘要。

description.en: A clearer DeepSeek Harness sidebar with separate navigation and conversation regions and built-in widgets.
description.zh: 更清晰的 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，将导航区与会话区分开，并内置若干小组件。

description.zh: 一个归代理所有的 Chromium 边车，镜像到 DeepSeek Harness 右栏：代理操控它，人可以观看并随时接管鼠标，登录状态在重启后保留。

description.en: DSH plugin: star any instruction you send and keep it in a left-sidebar page and a right-sidebar panel — search, edit, copy, or refill the composer with one click.
description.zh: DSH 插件：收藏你发出的任意指令，保存在左侧边栏页面和右侧边栏面板中——可搜索、编辑、复制，或一键回填到输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-irc-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏的 IRC 客户端：宿主用 node tls/net 直连 IRC（也可选走本机代理的 HTTP CONNECT 隧道），右侧栏收发消息，Agent 也能读和发（irc_panel 工具）。
plugins.author: lemonhall

description.en: Access gate for AI coding harnesses (DSH plugin + Claude Code hook): per-directory deny/read/full, roster groups, audit log, model-facing tools with owner-approved widening.
description.zh: AI 编码 harness 的访问门（DSH 插件 + Claude Code hook）：按目录设置禁止/只读/完全权限、名册分组、审计日志，以及需所有者批准才能放宽的模型可见工具。

description.en: Jev (TypeSafe System One) judgments at the DeepSeek Harness agent-loop gates: pre-step, pre-execute, post-execute, and turn-stopping. No UI dependencies; mount it in any Harness composition.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 代理循环关口做 Jev (TypeSafe System One) 判定：步前、执行前、执行后和轮次停止。无 UI 依赖，可挂载到任意 Harness 组合中。

plugins.name: dsh-jiuling-remote-desktop
plugins.description: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。

plugins.name: dsh-jiuling-remote-mobile
plugins.description: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

description.en: Dedicated background-job dashboard for DSH: all sessions, progress, grouping, and live output.
description.zh: DSH 专用的后台任务仪表盘：所有会话、进度、分组和实时输出。

description.en: Refuses Git inside a Jujutsu workspace and hands the model the jj command instead. A tiered jj tool surface, multi-agent coordination, prompt teaching, and a jj-hunk bridge for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 Jujutsu 工作区内拒绝 Git，改为把 jj 命令交给模型。为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层的 jj 工具面、多代理协作、提示词引导和 jj-hunk 桥接。

description.en: DSH plugin: offline JVM production-report diagnostics — thread dumps with Java-level deadlock cycles, GC-log pause percentiles, Maven/Gradle dependency conflicts, exception chains and Spring config diffs. Never touches a running process: no jcmd, no jstac
description.zh: DSH 插件：离线 JVM 生产报告诊断——线程转储含 Java 级死锁环、GC 日志停顿分位数、Maven/Gradle 依赖冲突、异常链和 Spring 配置差异。绝不接触运行中的进程：不调用 jcmd 或 jstack。

plugins.name: dsh-key-switch
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: keep several DeepSeek API keys, switch the active one in one click, and see each key's live balance in the sidebar. 多个 API Key 池 + 一键切换 + 实时余额。
plugins.author: NoahLu

description.en: Global keyboard shortcuts: focus the composer and switch to the 1st-9th sidebar session, with a numbered hint badge while the modifier is held.
description.zh: 全局键盘快捷键：聚焦输入框并切换到侧边栏第 1–9 个会话，按住修饰键时显示带编号的提示徽标。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness tools for the Kimi browser extension (WebBridge) and KimiCU desktop control: kimi_browser_* drives the user's real logged-in browser, kimi_cu_* observes and operates Windows desktops.
description.zh: 面向 Kimi 浏览器扩展 (WebBridge) 和 KimiCU 桌面控制的原生 DeepSeek Harness 工具：kimi_browser_* 驱动用户真实已登录的浏览器，kimi_cu_* 观察并操作 Windows 桌面。

description.en: Use a Kimi Code membership in DeepSeek Harness through a dedicated Kimi subscription model route
description.zh: 通过专用的 Kimi 订阅模型路由，在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 Kimi Code 会员。

plugins.name: dsh-lan-relay
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 局域网中继插件：一台机器在 DSH 进程内做 hub，其余机器粘贴加入码即可加入；跨机器 Agent 消息互通、离线补投、自动唤醒会话，标准 DSH bundle，装完即用。
plugins.author: ready-player-zero

plugins.name: dsh-lean
plugins.description: DeepSeek bills peak hours at 2x, and peak is 09-12 and 14-18 Beijing time. npx dsh-lean audit shows what your session paid and what it costs off-peak. DeepSeek 峰时按 2 倍计费，峰时正好是上班时间。

plugins.name: dsh-ledger-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏的记账本：记一笔（金额/分类/备注）、本月支出收入结余、按分类统计；数据全在本地，Agent 也能读写（ledger_panel 工具）。
plugins.author: lemonhall

plugins.name: dsh-life-pack
plugins.description: 爱生活总管插件：单 DSH设置面板槽（爱生活卡）+ 爱生活页签槽 children，技能设置页动态聚合，不依赖单品、不 import 单品页

plugins.name: dsh-line-bot
plugins.description: 把 LINE 官方帳號（Messaging API）接進 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：內建 Cloudflare Tunnel、人設選擇（大肥魚或插件自訂）、主動傳訊與完整設定面板。
plugins.author: Hanson0901

plugins.name: dsh-links-panel
plugins.description: Reference links panel for DeepSeek Harness: collects every URL of a conversation into the right sidebar with pins, turn counts, metadata and favicon caching. DSH 右栏「参考链接」面板。

description.en: On-demand memory for the DeepSeek Harness: nothing resident, at most three small cards on a real hit, bodies read on demand.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按需记忆：无任何常驻内容，真正命中时最多给出三张小卡片，正文按需读取。

plugins.name: dsh-live-token-stats
plugins.description: 「DSH·实时 Token 统计·溺水检测」：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表，在 composer 下方实时渲染 token 状态带，显示流式 TPS、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比上次 step 的估算与实际偏差；纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码

description.en: DSH web plugin: show a Live2D character at the bottom corner of the DeepSeek Harness web page, with a load progress bar and a settings section that controls the whole widget behavior (model URL, size, position, scale, opacity, drag, volume, …) through the
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 网页角落显示 Live2D 角色，带加载进度条和设置区，可控制整个挂件的全部行为（模型 URL、尺寸、位置、缩放、不透明度、拖动、音量等）。

plugins.name: dsh-live2dwaifu
plugins.description: 给 DSH 网页右下角请一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、视线跟着鼠标、点她有反应、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动。模型不用内置——谁装谁放自己的文件夹；支持自定义 .exp3.json 表情和 .motion3.json 动作，卡片能拖能缩，背景可换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads each configured provider's remaining balance or subscription quota and shows it in an always-visible card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 用于查询 LLM 服务提供方用量的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：读取每个已配置提供方的剩余余额或订阅配额，并在 Web GUI 的常驻卡片中显示。

description.en: Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
description.zh: 当 LLM 请求持续失败（重试耗尽、鉴权、配额、限流）时，为 DeepSeek Harness 代理自动切换提供方/模型回退链。

description.en: Local-model (Ollama) integration for DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route requests to them by task type or keyword with automatic fallback to the cloud, and get a one-shot status overview via /ollama.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地模型 (Ollama) 集成：发现、拉取、移除和检查本地模型，按任务类型或关键词把请求路由到本地，并自动回退到云端，还可用 /ollama 一次查看状态概览。

description.en: Import DeepSeek chat exports into regular local DSH Go conversations.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 聊天导出导入为普通的本地 DSH Go 对话。

description.en: Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web client, with local Russian speech recognition for voice input
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的俄语本地化，并为语音输入提供本地俄语语音识别。

description.en: Whole-disk, millisecond file search for DeepSeek Harness without Everything: a self-built cross-platform index, an Everything-style query language, agent tools and a Web search panel (Ctrl+Shift+F). Windows, macOS and Linux.
description.zh: 无需 Everything，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全盘毫秒级文件搜索：自建的跨平台索引、Everything 风格查询语法、代理工具和 Web 搜索面板 (Ctrl+Shift+F)。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: the prompt sees only a stable index, full text is one lookup away. Bi-temporal facts, strict scope isolation, verified-only injection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：提示中只看到稳定的索引，全文一次查询即可获得。双时间维事实、严格作用域隔离、仅注入已验证内容。

description.en: Unofficial third-party gate for dsh session-log upload.
description.zh: dsh 会话日志上传的非官方第三方门禁。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over language servers, plus the editor action protocol (lsp.actions.*) that makes the plugin the IDE integra
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 LSP 操作面：基于语言服务器提供诊断、格式化、补全、代码操作、符号、签名帮助、内联提示和重命名工具，并提供编辑器操作协议 (lsp.actions.*)，让该插件成为 IDE 集成。

plugins.name: dsh-m
plugins.description: 自定义清单的 DSH 插件市场：社区与精选双目录，收录/安装/卸载/升级，agent 工具与 dshm CLI，支持 web 与 desktop。

plugins.name: dsh-malleable-memory
plugins.description: 可塑性记忆（Malleable Memory）— DeepSeek-Harness 的三层记忆与人格插件：永久层/加强层每轮全文注入，卸载层只给目录、正文按需取回；记忆随对话演化，人格与心情随经历改变。
plugins.author: zbkyj

plugins.name: dsh-manage-session
plugins.description: DSH Web 插件：会话管理台 —— 统一管理活跃与归档会话（列表/筛选/收藏/归档与取消归档/批量清理/删除），外加四门会话体检。侧栏入口优先落在顶部工具槽位（插件行之后），宿主无该槽位时回落底栏。不维护索引、不依赖 DRS；搜索能力由 dsh-search-index 提供。（原名 dsh-session-steward，2.0.0 起搜索能力拆回 dsh-search-index）

description.en: DSH-owned workspaces created under a configurable base directory, with multiple linked folders per workspace.
description.zh: DSH 自有的工作区：创建在可配置的基础目录下，每个工作区可关联多个文件夹。

plugins.name: dsh-maoying
plugins.description: 毛颖 — DSH 网文创作辅助插件：主编 + 五帮手编排（大纲/写手/审校/设定/考据），novel/ 结构化文件为数据库

description.en: MathLab — a graduate-level mathematics research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: symbolic computation, abstract algebra, category theory, mathematical logic, Lean 4, plotting and a searchable symbol atlas.
description.zh: MathLab——DeepSeek Harness 的研究生级数学研究工作台：符号计算、抽象代数、范畴论、数理逻辑、Lean 4、绘图，以及可搜索的符号图集。

description.en: Curated, verified MCP server bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, with a connectivity verifier and CI checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的精选、经验证的 MCP 服务器包：一次安装即带来 demo、memory、filesystem、GitHub、Playwright 和远程 HTTP MCP 服务器，并提供连通性验证器和 CI 检查。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-management
plugins.description: MCP 管理（全局 / 项目）：直接编辑 mcp.yml，项目级 MCP 挂在会话自己的 Agent 作用域里，改完热生效

description.en: MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: /mcp command with health diagnostics and pipeline trial calls, a Settings MCP tab with server CRUD (append-only profile-patch fragments, approval-gated writes with automatic backups), a
description.zh: 官方 DeepSeek Harness MCP 客户端的管理控制台：/mcp 命令提供健康诊断与试调用，设置页可增删改服务器，写入需审批并自动备份。

plugins.name: dsh-media-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏的媒体台：把抖音/YouTube 链接丢进来，本机 yt-dlp 下载、ffmpeg 转 16k 单声道 WAV、官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）转写，字幕进面板，Agent 一键总结。
plugins.author: lemonhall

plugins.name: dsh-media-gen
plugins.description: DSH 生图+生视频整合插件：统一多供应商目录（OpenAI 兼容 images/chat 网关、DashScope 通义万相、火山 Seedance、Google Veo、Sora 风格 /v1/videos 异步任务含 input_reference 图生视频），提供 image_generate / generate_video / animate_image 工具，对话内联显示、图片与视频画廊、统一设置面板。Fork 合并自 dsh-image-generation 与 dsh-video-gen

description.en: Media evidence lens + provider router for DeepSeek Harness: media_read_video / media_read_audio / media_read_image turn local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / regions) via host-registered multimodal models first, configured OpenAI-c
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的媒体证据与提供商路由插件：media_read_video/audio/image 通过多模态模型把本地媒体转为结构化证据（时间线/转写/区域）。

description.en: MedXpert agent-skill collection (21 skills) packaged as a dsh profile bundle: NMPA / FDA / EU MDR / PMDA medical-device regulatory workflows.
description.zh: MedXpert Agent 技能合集（21 个技能），打包为 dsh 配置 bundle：NMPA / FDA / EU MDR / PMDA 医疗器械法规工作流。

plugins.name: dsh-medical-pipeline
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：医疗数据采集治理自动化流水线（清洗、ICD-10 编码、质控、脱敏、入库）+ 数据工厂动画可视化，数据全程本地处理。Medical data governance pipeline for DeepSeek Harness with an animated factory view.
plugins.author: wufengyuan88988

plugins.name: dsh-memory-doctor
plugins.description: 深鲸记忆：跨会话热记忆（每轮注入 MEMORY/USER + memory 工具读写）+ 记忆体检、瘦身归档、记忆包、诊断报告、会话提炼 digest、审计账本（哈希链/可溯源）、压缩可拦截/可预览/可撤销。本地明文、零依赖、不上传数据
plugins.author: 温州深鲸智能科技有限公司

plugins.name: dsh-memory-engine
plugins.description: DSH 本地记忆插件：自动记忆、遗忘曲线、关键词关联、可检索可编辑，数据留在本机。
plugins.author: dsh-memory-engine contributors

description.en: Local-first, file-native long-term memory hub: preflight, compact context injection, citations, human-approved commits, temporal validity, dedupe/merge, retrospective reflection, write-risk flags, a derived SQLite index, per-workspace scheduled distillati
description.zh: 本地优先、文件原生的长期记忆中心：预检、精简上下文注入、引用、人工确认提交、时效性、去重合并、反思、写入风险标记、SQLite 索引与按工作区定时蒸馏。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-nebula
plugins.description: Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness — read-only graph, spreading recall, evidence chains, offline snapshots. 记忆星图：把 DSH 各工作区的记忆只读连成一张可交互星云。
plugins.author: 主人 & 小代码酱

plugins.name: dsh-memu-memory
plugins.description: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件：三层记忆、逐轮召回、来源标注、关系图、图片附件与独立 WebUI。

description.en: Render Mermaid code blocks in DeepSeek Harness with a diagram/code toggle.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中渲染 Mermaid 代码块，可在图表与代码间切换。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that renders a conversation's Mermaid diagrams in the right Sidebar, not inline in the chat.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏（而非聊天气泡内）渲染对话中的 Mermaid 图表。

plugins.name: dsh-metaphysics
plugins.description: 烛微命盘（玄学 xuanxue）for DeepSeek Harness: twenty-four systems and thirteen quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, a daily fortune slip and a 100-lot Guanyin oracle, …), with climate adjustment (tiaohou), the 120 Qiongtong Baojian entries, 1,062-ch
plugins.author: xuanfu-web

description.en: Realtime model usage panel: tokens, cost, requests, trend and composition
description.zh: 实时模型用量面板：token、费用、请求数、趋势与构成。

plugins.name: dsh-mind
plugins.description: 心智 · 数字组织 —— 一张插件卡，三个组件：内核 / 安全类 / 看板

plugins.name: dsh-mini
plugins.description: DSH 常驻小窗插件：把当前会话一键弹出为独立置顶小窗（WebView2 原生窗口），含整屏/框选截图、划词「问大肥鱼」、全局快捷键与截图自动复制

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-use
plugins.description: 把真手机装进 DSH 右栏：实时镜像可以直接点、圈一处标注回传会话，模型不截图也能读界面文本树。只走本机回环，不上传画面。
plugins.author: dsh-mobile-use contributors

description.en: A free pool that combines official free API quotas behind one key (soon-to-expire first, never charges you), daily check-in credits claimed for you (Trae, Qoder, WorkBuddy, MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi…), one OpenAI-compatible address that relays every model,
description.zh: 合并官方免费 API 额度到一个 key 的免费池：优先用临期额度、绝不扣费，自动领取每日签到积分，并提供 OpenAI 兼容地址中转所有模型。

description.en: Automatically probe a model route's reasoning-effort levels and context window, then fill them into the DSH model configuration page.
description.zh: 自动探测模型路由的推理强度档位与上下文窗口，并填入 DSH 模型配置页。

plugins.name: dsh-model-master
plugins.description: dsh-model-master（模型选择大师）for DeepSeek Harness — 15-language UI (top-15 world languages) — 保留 DSH 原生模型按钮与菜单，在原版狭小下拉列表即将弹出时无缝接管为 Spotlight 大面板。集成 TTFT/TPS 流式测速（失败如实展示、绝不编造数据）、原生渠道分组、⚡ 智能优选、全球百强榜（点击行搜本机渠道）；内置推理档位 FX（官方菜单推理等级行滑条 + 档位切换芯片能量闪动）；原生模型位被其它插件占用时自动出现
plugins.author: NEETnina

plugins.name: dsh-model-names
plugins.description: 内置 provider / 模型显示名的全量数据库：载入时按环境里实际启用的 provider 与模型覆盖显示名，只影响 UI，不改路由、请求与凭据。

description.en: A grouped, searchable replacement for the DSH composer model selector.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框的模型选择器提供分组、可搜索的替代界面。

plugins.name: dsh-model-refresh
plugins.description: 独立模型数据源与官方清单发现，基于证据规划 pi-ai 补缺、待确认与宽限移除；可恢复目录事务、内容与修订所有权校验，附 provider 设置及监控。

plugins.name: dsh-model-think-level
plugins.description: 在官方「模型」页为第三方模型补上思考等级、图片输入与生图，并支持一个供应商多把密钥、按模型分流与失败自动换密钥重试、按路由自定义请求头、余额展示与自动继续。
plugins.author: GaoHu1997

plugins.name: dsh-mt-mcp
plugins.description: MT 管理器 MCP 连接（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：在 Web 设置页填写 MT 的 MCP 地址，手机文件/APK/ZIP 能力以 mcp__mt__* 工具可用
plugins.author: aikunx

description.en: Split the DSH main area into up to four panes, each with its own tab strip, composer and view switcher. Drag a tab to a pane edge to split. Bilingual (zh/en).
description.zh: 把 DSH 主区域拆分为最多四个窗格，每个都有独立标签栏、输入框与视图切换，拖动标签到边缘即可分割。支持中英双语。

description.en: 2-4 real Chats you rearrange entirely from the keyboard, save as named layouts, and jump through by which pane needs you.
description.zh: 2–4 个真实聊天，可完全用键盘重排、保存为命名布局，并按哪个窗格需要你而跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-music-panel

plugins.description: DSH 原生 MUV 引擎 —— 正则脚本、状态栏级联（任意字段/行动选项）、变量追踪、LaTeX、宏展开、标签 CSS、visual 代码块渲染（信纸/终端/报纸/手机），内置 diag.mjs 诊断工具。需与伴生插件 dsh-muv-table 一起安装

plugins.name: dsh-muv-table

plugins.name: dsh-napcat-keeper

plugins.author: 熙的大肥鱼

description.en: Network & proxy assistant for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one-shot GitHub connectivity check, system proxy status, proxy port probing, full diag chain (DNS/TCP/HTTP) and hosts-file conflict scan — built from real-world China-network experience.

description.en: Suggested follow-up prompts for DeepSeek Harness chat: AI-generated next steps as clickable cards under every agent turn — one click sends the reply, zero typing. 15 languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聊天中的追问建议：每轮回复下方以可点击卡片给出 AI 生成的下一步，一点即发送，零输入。支持 15 种语言。

description.en: Niubash-only shell executor and Bash-dialect teaching for DeepSeek Harness (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, and the 0.1.7-rc.x line it shares its shell seam with): every ctx.shell execution runs as `niu -c`, PowerShell/cmd/WSL/nu handoffs are refused, PowerShell habits a
description.zh: Niu 专用的 shell 执行器与 Bash 方言教学：所有 ctx.shell 执行都以 niu -c 运行，拒绝 PowerShell/cmd/WSL/nu 转交。

plugins.name: dsh-no-guess
plugins.description: DSH 插件：需求不清楚时先问再干 — block tool calls on unclear requests, ask before guessing

description.en: Windows system notifications when a DeepSeek Harness session needs your approval, an answer, or has completed a turn
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 会话需要审批、回答或完成一轮时发送 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Desktop that actually speak: Windows TTS out of the box (zero download), VOICEVOX voice packs optional, a selectable system-sound fallback, and an idle gate that waits for running subagents before saying the turn is done. Inc
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的桌面通知，会真正发声：默认使用 Windows TTS（零下载），可选 VOICEVOX 语音包与系统提示音，并等待子代理结束后才宣布本轮完成。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-tray
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 通知 + 状态栏插件：任务完成、需要输入、需要选择时弹系统通知（macOS / Windows / Linux）；macOS 与 Linux（含 UOS、Deepin、麒麟）状态栏常驻小图标，显示任务进度与花费。Windows 没有状态栏，只弹通知。
plugins.author: ROYLeXJ

plugins.name: dsh-novel-forge
plugins.description: AI 写长篇的四个死法：设定崩、看不见前文、水文超字数、满屏 AI 味——这个插件全用代码堵死。细纲不批准就不给写章，设定改值直接拒绝，重复句段机审拦下，八维去 AI 味扫描零 token。右侧栏锻炉面板带听书、全书体检、批量起草断点续跑；24 个 novel_* 工具，你只管讲故事，把关交给代码。Novel-writing guardrails plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
plugins.author: huangziyuan-general

description.en: Novel studio for DeepSeek Harness: a draggable story timeline, world snapshots, chapter outlines, and chapters written by the work's own agent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说工作室：可拖动的故事时间线、世界快照、章节大纲，以及由作品自带代理撰写章节。

plugins.name: dsh-novel-writer
plugins.description: 小说写作助手插件（22 个工具）：覆盖「动笔前取材料 → 写完量化自检 → 改稿按优先级复测 → 跨章结构体检 → 收尾清理与诊断」整条流程。含句式模式分析、情感量化与氛围光谱、风格画像报告、文笔六维基线带、本地语义检索（离线）、章节库浏览与摘要、设定表与伏笔登记、原创模式创作资料、连贯性审计（衔接/OOC/大纲对照）、开写包、改稿台与对抗性审计（严格对账 / 独立 AI 任务书 / 证据复核）；实时聊天写作把半成品逐段写入独立目录的草稿镜像（只追加，何时停下来问人由程序的字数阈值判定）；必用词表支持书级

description.en: Nushell-only shell executor, dialect preflight, and Nushell syntax teaching for DeepSeek Harness (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, and the 0.1.7-rc.x line it shares its shell seam with): every ctx.shell execution runs as `nu --no-config-file -c`, other shells are refused,

description.en: Office documents, PDF, presentations, and spreadsheets for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Office 文档、PDF、演示文稿与表格能力。

description.en: Claude Code for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a model provider, with live models, session resume, approvals, rewind, memory and remote SSH workspaces

plugins.author: ShOpenMind

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-office-markdown

description.zh: Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 插件包：把 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7（或强制 Windows PowerShell 5.1），删除操作一律进回收站，并附设置页。

description.en: Desktop notification and a short chime when a DeepSeek Harness session finishes or stops to wait for your answer.

description.en: Inject soulbridge context into DSH sessions and feed user turns back as observations.
description.zh: 把 soulbridge 上下文注入 DSH 会话，并将用户轮次作为观察反馈回去。

plugins.description: DSH 核心角色扮演与多形态矩阵引擎：注册 tlrp 设置命名空间、可自由增删的 modes 形态矩阵、/mode 与形态别名指令拦截、{{tlrp_character}}/{{tlrp_directive}}/{{tlrp_memory_context}}/{{now}} 动态变量、每轮尾部实时状态与 tlmemory 记忆桥注入，并按形态的 toolPolicy 物理拦截工具。

description.en: DSH token usage dashboard: a draggable, position-remembering pill with daily/weekly consumption charts
description.zh: DSH token 用量看板：可拖动并记住位置的胶囊标签，附每日与每周消耗图表。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.

description.en: Multi-engine web search for DeepSeek Harness: an aggregated ctx.web search provider (auto-routing + sequential fallback, free engines keep search alive) plus a web_search_pro model tool with per-query engine choice, fan-out, batch and verticals — Brave, B
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多引擎网页搜索：聚合的 ctx.web 搜索提供者（自动路由与顺序回退），加带每查询引擎选择、扇出、批量与垂直领域的 web_search_pro 模型工具。

description.en: Weixin (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness — command a DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription.
