description.en: Freezes the whole desktop from a scissors button in the DSH composer, crops a dragged region, and inserts it into the prompt as an image attachment. The shot is stored once in the DSH attachment library, indexed per session. Windows only.
description.zh: 从 DSH 输入框的剪刀按钮冻结整个桌面，裁切拖选区域并以图片附件插入提示词；截图存入 DSH 附件库并按会话索引。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的宿主级主动唤醒：让模型自行安排闹钟（单次、间隔、带抖动的 cron），准时唤醒冷会话，并用安静时段与每日预算约束模型发起的追问。

description.en: Personal usage profile page for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: tokens and spend by range, longest task, activity streaks, cache hit rate, a 12-month token-activity heatmap, model distribution, token stats by content, projects and a per-provider breakdown, a
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的个人用量档案页：按区间统计 token 与花费、最长任务、活跃连续天数、缓存命中率、12 个月热力图、模型分布与各提供商明细。

description.en: A task progress bar for the DSH Web GUI. Host-inject mode: the host half serves /dsh-progress-bar/state and injects plain JS through webserver/index-inject; it deliberately declares no client half. The progress source defaults to $DSH_HOME/dsh-progress/st
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的任务进度条。宿主注入模式：宿主半侧提供 /dsh-progress-bar/state，并通过 webserver/index-inject 注入纯 JS，刻意不声明客户端半侧。

description.en: Private, per-project system-prompt rules for DeepSeek Harness — matched by git remote URL, repo path, or cwd prefix; worktree-aware; never committed to the repository.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的私有按项目系统提示规则：按 git remote URL、仓库路径或 cwd 前缀匹配，感知 worktree，且从不提交到仓库。

description.en: Browse and manage project-level and global skills from the DSH right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏浏览和管理项目级与全局技能。

description.en: Optimize the incoming prompt against session context and proactively ask the user about blocking ambiguities before the agent runs.
description.zh: 结合会话上下文优化输入的提示词，并在代理运行前主动就阻塞性歧义询问用户。

description.en: Preview-first prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: it clarifies a draft without inventing facts, asks instead of filling placeholders, and writes back only when you click apply.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的预览优先提示词增强：在不编造事实的前提下澄清草稿，遇到占位符先提问，只有点击应用才写回。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the dsh web GUI: rewrite the composer draft into a well-structured prompt through the harness LLM service, preview the before/after, then fill back, copy, or undo. Original draft is always preserved.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 的提示词增强：经 harness LLM 服务把草稿改写为结构良好的提示词，预览前后对比后可填回、复制或撤销，原稿始终保留。

description.en: DSH web plugin for the composer: shell-style prompt history (Up/Down with prefix search, Ctrl+R reverse search), Codex-style completion ghosted after the caret — history first, then a model continuation of the half-written message — plus next-prompt predi
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框插件：shell 式历史（上下键前缀搜索、Ctrl+R 反向搜索）、光标后的补全幽灵文本（先历史、后模型续写），以及下一条提示词预测。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-setting
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 默认 System Prompt 管理插件：在 Web GUI「设置」里浏览、检索并覆盖最终装配进每轮会话的系统提示词。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: adds an "Add another key" action to every pi-ai provider card, cloning the same upstream under a new provider route with its own API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为每个 pi-ai 提供商卡片添加“添加另一个 key”操作，以新提供商路由克隆同一上游并使用独立 API key。

description.en: PTC-Lite agent preset, its prompt trim, and its terse tool results
description.zh: PTC-Lite 代理预设、其提示词裁剪与简洁的工具结果。

plugins.name: dsh-pterodactyl
plugins.description: Pterodactyl 面板 Agent 工具：服务器状态、电源、备份、文件与 WebSocket 控制台。
plugins.author: mykodb

description.en: DSH host-side phone push: question events to ntfy + in-process answering via relay polling (replaces the external notifier + answer bridge)
description.zh: DSH 宿主侧手机推送：把提问事件推送到 ntfy，并通过中继轮询在进程内作答。

description.en: DSH plugin: deterministic, offline Python/Django production-report diagnostics — traceback root cause, pytest summaries, unapplied migrations, N+1 SQL, manage.py check --deploy and Celery backlog. Does not execute Python, start subprocesses or touch the n
description.zh: DSH 插件：确定性的离线 Python/Django 生产报告诊断——回溯根因、pytest 摘要、未应用迁移、N+1 SQL、部署检查与 Celery 积压；不执行 Python。

plugins.name: dsh-qoder-connect
plugins.description: 将 Qoder（国内版 / 国际版）的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring Qoder (CN & international) models into DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.author: corrinehu

plugins.name: dsh-qq-access
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 接入插件：NapCat 托管、消息归档、QQ 空间、表情包、虚拟人生、情感关系、长期记忆与群聊智能回复。
plugins.author: Applepinea

plugins.name: dsh-qq-email
plugins.description: 用已授权的 agently-cli 发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具，并对外提供 Cordis 服务 ctx.qqEmail 供其他 DSH 插件调用。
plugins.author: altmanWang

plugins.name: dsh-qq-moony
plugins.description: 把 QQ 小号接进 DeepSeek Harness：收发消息、发表情包、发 QQ 空间说说、参与群聊，能自己找话题，自带启动与限速防封。
plugins.author: Seventy-JJ

description.en: QQ channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness via OneBot 11 / NapCat — private chats and group chats with your agent.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 11 / NapCat 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 QQ 渠道插件：与代理私聊和群聊。

plugins.name: dsh-qqbot-lite
plugins.description: DSH 的轻量 QQ 机器人插件（零运行时依赖）：WebSocket 收群聊/私聊消息接入 dsh 会话，并提供 qq_message / qq_group / qq_bot 三个工具供 AI 主动调用（发消息、发文件、读消息、按需下载附件、群管理、查状态）。自带「设置 → QQ 机器人」页面，支持手机 QQ 扫码绑定，无需手抄凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-qqmail-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏的 QQ 邮箱：读最近邮件、看正文、发纯文本（发送需 confirm 门禁）。凭据只从私有 secret.json 读，授权码绝不进 git、不进日志、不回显。
plugins.author: lemonhall

description.en: Mechanism-enforced discipline layer for DeepSeek Harness agent teams: role cards, quorum termination, evidence-gated reports and cost budgets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代理团队的机制化纪律层：角色卡、法定人数终止、证据门控报告与成本预算。

plugins.name: dsh-radio-dock
plugins.description: 把 godot_citys 里的车载电台搬进 DSH 右侧栏：three.js 车内视角 + 会弯的夜路 + radio-browser 网络电台（City Pop）。
plugins.author: lemonhall

description.en: RAGFlow knowledge base over MCP for DeepSeek Harness — configuration-only bundle (no runtime code)
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的、基于 MCP 的 RAGFlow 知识库——纯配置插件包（无运行时代码）。

description.en: Let a DeepSeek Harness agent actually see an animated GIF or animated WebP: decode every frame, sample the animation across time, and hand the model a labelled sequence of real frames instead of the single first frame the harness otherwise delivers.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 代理真正看到动图 GIF 或动态 WebP：解码每一帧、沿时间轴采样，把带标注的真实帧序列交给模型。

description.en: Visual feedback & design review for DeepSeek Harness: click any UI element in the browser, comment, tweak CSS live, and send structured context + screenshot to your agent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的视觉反馈与设计评审：在浏览器中点击任意 UI 元素、留言、实时调整 CSS，并把结构化上下文与截图发给代理。

plugins.name: dsh-redteam-mode
plugins.description: DSH RedTeam 模式：一句话拉起红队作战智能体（资产测绘 / 得分目标 / 报告 / POC 知识库），含六个角色、38 个原生技能（29 个随 npm 包）、常驻右侧控制台与一键自动更新
plugins.author: Jueze

plugins.name: dsh-reference-session-collector
plugins.description: DSH Web 插件：会话原文投影同步器（DRS）——只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions 会话日志，解码后投影进自有 SQLite（segments/replaces/FTS5），经 /api/dsh-reference-session-collector 提供 surface 标记、召回对账与内容检索面。绝不写会话文件。

description.en: Provision a separate DSH_HOME (minimal profile + launcher) for the AgentRouter relay, and give the sandboxed agent controlled network egress.
description.zh: 为 AgentRouter 中继准备独立的 DSH_HOME（最小配置加启动器），并为沙箱化代理提供受控的网络出口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness patch set that intercepts MALFORMED_RESPONSE streams, splits fused tool-call arguments, re-throws unprovable buffers, and names the deterministic refusals it does not retry.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 补丁集：拦截 MALFORMED_RESPONSE 流，拆分粘连的工具调用参数，重抛无法证明的缓冲区，并命名不重试的确定性拒绝。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness: idle sessions are extracted and consolidated into a searchable file-based memory workspace, then recalled through prompt injection with citation tracking, a settings page, a sidebar status entry and
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：把空闲会话提取整合为可搜索的文件式记忆工作区，再经提示词注入召回并跟踪引用，附设置页与侧边栏状态条目。

description.en: Versioned REST bridge for DeepSeek Harness: remote access for trusted clients (chat, files, devices) plus a Phone-settings panel inside the DSH WebUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的版本化 REST 桥：为受信客户端提供远程访问（聊天、文件、设备），并在 DSH WebUI 内提供手机设置面板。

description.en: Remote connections manager for DeepSeek Harness: manage multiple SSH machines (password or key), auto-connect on startup, pick remote workspaces in the workspace add-flow, and operate remote files directly via remote_* tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程连接管理：管理多台 SSH 机器（密码或密钥）、启动时自动连接、在添加工作区时选择远程目录，并通过 remote_* 工具操作远程文件。

description.en: Remote control for DSH: a Devices panel that discovers other DSH desktops signed into the same account, pairs with them once, and drives their sessions.
description.zh: DSH 远程控制：设备面板可发现同一账号下的其他 DSH 桌面端，一次配对后即可驱动其会话。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-plugin
plugins.description: DSH Remote 官方 bundle 插件：更多菜单中的手机连接入口、首次连接提示与浏览器管理控制台；内置网关自动启停，支持手机远程会话、审批、文件互传和设备管理。

description.en: One-line DeepSeek Harness bundle that moves the execution world into a crash-resilient, heartbeat-kept, workspace-synced E2B sandbox.
description.zh: 一行命令的 DeepSeek Harness 插件包，把执行环境迁移到抗崩溃、带心跳并同步工作区的 E2B 沙箱。

description.en: Remote hassle-free access for DeepSeek Harness: a cloudflared quick tunnel plus a scannable QR code and settings shown in the Settings → Plugins page. Zero runtime dependencies, no database, no Firebase.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省心远程访问：cloudflared 快速隧道加可扫描二维码，设置项显示在设置 → 插件页。零运行时依赖、无数据库、无 Firebase。

plugins.name: dsh-remotion
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness React 视频创作工作台：内置官方 Remotion 技能、工程检索、模板库、素材排序、Studio 预览与本地 MP4 导出，支持原生清透 / 米白纸感 / Claude 暖书卷 / 8-Bit 像素 / 晴空薄荷五套明亮工作台主题。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
plugins.author: stardustlc

plugins.name: dsh-request-doctor
plugins.description: 自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。

description.en: Provider request metadata minimization extension for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提供商请求元数据最小化扩展。

plugins.name: dsh-research-team-preset
plugins.description: A DSH agent preset that turns one session into a small, coordinated research team; 科研团队模式，覆盖文献、数据、设计、实现、实验、复核与论文产出的端到端科研协作。
plugins.author: Ruixin Zhan

description.en: Not a session importer. One-shot reunion_continue (import+load) for light THREAD continuation (~3.5k chars), plus portable persona/memory for DeepSeek exports and share links.
description.zh: 不是会话导入器。为轻量 THREAD 续接提供一次性的 reunion_continue（导入并加载），并为 DeepSeek 导出与分享链接提供可移植人格与记忆。

description.en: Rhine Lab inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness: boot splash, interface theme, brand marks and extras
description.zh: 受 Rhine Lab 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 主题：启动画面、界面主题、品牌标识与额外内容。

description.en: DSH-native skill intelligence cockpit: task decomposition, cross-domain multi-skill composition, skill authoring, local recommendations and safety scans for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 原生技能智能驾驶舱：任务分解、跨领域多技能组合、技能编写、本地推荐与安全扫描。

plugins.name: dsh-roost
plugins.description: 把 QQ 开放平台的官方机器人接进 DeepSeek Harness：接入向导一键装好内核与对话插件，每个会话独立持久上下文，三层记忆（事实/日记/图谱），情绪状态影响主动搭话，按说话人分档收放本地工具，扩展以 MCP server 形式装载。

plugins.name: dsh-roundtable-harness
plugins.description: 多模型圆桌辩论插件：让 DSH 里已配置的多个 AI 带着各自人设围绕同一话题多轮互喷，共享上下文，裁判按六维（攻击性/逻辑/人设还原度/趣味度/策略/深度）加权打分，性价比另用 dsh-cost-meter 真实账本单列，输出 Markdown 战报与 docx。Multi-model roundtable debate plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.author: HSM266

description.en: A lightweight, selectable smart-routing mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轻量、可选择的智能路由模式。

plugins.name: dsh-rss
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness RSS / Atom 订阅工作台：分类来源目录、先预览再订阅、检索与 OPML 导入导出，支持 5 套工作台主题（原生清透 / 米白纸感 / Claude 暖书卷 / 8-Bit 像素 / 晴空薄荷）与微交互动效。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
plugins.author: stardustlc

plugins.name: dsh-rss-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏的 RSS 阅读器：订阅源在配置里，条目按时间排，可标已读/收藏；宿主抓取，走本机代理。
plugins.author: lemonhall

description.en: Live daily earnings accrued from a monthly salary and work schedule in the time zone you pick, with a per-day ledger, a ticker page, and a composer pill.
description.zh: 按所选时区依据月薪与排班实时累计当日收入，附每日账本、行情页与输入框胶囊。

description.en: Give a sandboxed DeepSeek Harness agent network egress: one fetch tool that runs the request in the host process, against a configurable host allowlist, while the sandbox keeps its write boundary.
description.zh: 为沙箱化的 DeepSeek Harness 代理提供网络出口：单一 fetch 工具在宿主进程中按可配置域名白名单发起请求，沙箱写入边界不变。

plugins.name: dsh-sansheng-liubu
plugins.description: 三省六部 / Imperial Senate：把本机的 Claude Code / Codex / WorkBuddy / DSH 排成朝堂（或古罗马元老院），拟旨、封驳、并行办差、复核、批红合并，全程在隔离的 git 分支里进行；丞相府一次接下一摞事，分拣、排队、派发；装上即用，另有「一人公司」现代皮肤。
plugins.author: shilaoban666

description.en: Save DSH conversation turns into Markdown: a heart in the assistant action row, per-session collections in the sidebar, and a personal knowledge base the model can search on demand.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话轮次保存为 Markdown：回复操作行的心形按钮、侧边栏按会话归集，以及模型可按需检索的个人知识库。

plugins.name: dsh-sci-viz
plugins.description: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。零依赖，装上即用。
plugins.author: Astepluver

plugins.name: dsh-scientist
plugins.description: 科学家模式 — 面向数理/物理工程材料/AI 计算科学的 DSH agent preset：领域调研（分阶段 scan→scholar→map→papers→report）、文献检索（lit_* 4 个原生工具）、专业推导（sympy + pint + uncertainties + LaTeX）、出图与统计规范、版本化工件与溯源。

description.en: Community DeepSeek Harness bundle for SCNet SSH and OpenAPI jobs, files, Notebook resources, Slurm diagnostics, and Hygon DCU/DTK guidance.
description.zh: 面向 SCNet SSH 与 OpenAPI 作业、文件、Notebook 资源、Slurm 诊断及海光 DCU/DTK 指导的社区 DeepSeek Harness 插件包。

plugins.name: dsh-scope-manager
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 作用域管家：按「全局 / 工作区 / 会话」三层作用域管理角色卡、工具、技能、MCP 与预设，带侧边栏。Scope manager for DeepSeek Harness: presets, persona cards, tools, skills and MCP connections bound to global / workspace / session layers.

description.en: Codex-style scratch execution for DeepSeek Harness: operation scripts run from a session scratch root and are collected into a plugin-owned vault, so the workspace only ever holds real deliverables. Diverts new scratch writes, and retrofits residue that w
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 式草稿执行：操作脚本在会话草稿根目录运行并收进插件自有仓库，让工作区只留真正的交付物。

description.en: DSH-Search-Contrl: a DSH skill/plugin for scoped web search and Chinese reports on any topic. No default topic: it asks first, then picks sources from a topic preset table. Settings GUI for custom report titles, search sources, topics, creator links, post
description.zh: DSH-Search-Contrl：用于限定范围网页搜索与中文报告的 DSH 技能/插件。无默认主题，先询问再从主题预设表选源，并提供设置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-select-assist
plugins.description: DSH plugin: select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, or translate it with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a native always-on-top overlay (draggable, resizable). · DeepSeek Harness 划词工具：任意应用里选中文字即在锚点右下角弹出菜单，用 Harness 解释/总结/翻译（自动带上选区所在的上下文段落），流式
plugins.author: yjh248619

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar questions on a conversation fork and default-browser link opening. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：加入划词标注、原位翻译、会话派生侧边栏提问与默认浏览器打开链接，所选文本随下一条消息发送。

plugins.name: dsh-select-translate
plugins.description: 划词翻译 · 选中文字即在鼠标旁弹出只含译文的卡片
plugins.author: SHAN5246992ZHUI

description.en: Derived self-check for changed files: parses PowerShell/JS/JSON with the right tool, runs the tests that belong to each changed plugin or project, and reports a per-file verdict.
description.zh: 对改动文件做派生式自检：用对应工具解析 PowerShell/JS/JSON，运行每个受影响插件或项目的测试，并按文件给出结论。

plugins.name: dsh-semble
plugins.description: Semble 语义代码搜索（semantic code search）插件：安装即用，无需客户端配置。Semble semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness as native tools (semble_search / semble_find_related), powered by the Semble CLI via uvx.
plugins.author: Liu Kai

description.en: SEOmatic for DeepSeek Harness: the hosted SEOmatic MCP server (Search Console, audits, AI visibility, keyword and backlink research) plus a routing skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 SEOmatic：托管 SEOmatic MCP 服务器（Search Console、审计、AI 可见度、关键词与外链研究）加一个路由技能。

description.en: DSH session management: panel with archive/trash/delete/undo, automatic rename and interrupted-session resume, six-way session-log repair (structure, zstd frames, seq gaps, EIO blocks, dual-format conflict, tool arguments), value analysis, full-text searc
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：带归档、回收站、删除、撤销的面板，自动重命名与中断会话恢复、六向会话日志修复、价值分析、全文检索等。

plugins.name: dsh-session-continuity
plugins.description: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针；没有交接文档时优先复用上个会话的压缩摘要。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cost-meter
plugins.description: Per-session DeepSeek API cost meter with adaptive peak/off-peak (波峰/波谷) tariff
